## Content PR Checklist

- [ ] Linked coordinating Issue
- [ ] Changed files stay in the right domain folder
- [ ] New or changed Obsidian links resolve inside this shared vault
- [ ] User-facing copy is separated from internal implementation notes
- [ ] `Follow` and `Subscribe` meanings remain consistent with README
- [ ] Long rationale lives in files, not PR comments
